name: cache-tax
description: Warns before a message that would re-read the whole conversation on a cold prompt cache, shows the cache state in the status line, and can keep it warm with /keepwarm.

ttl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
ttl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after the last request: 1h on a subscription, 5m in usage overage.

minTokens.title: Warn above (tokens)
minTokens.description: Only stop a message when the context it re-sends is at least this big.

maxPings.title: Keep-warm pings
maxPings.description: With /keepwarm on, how many pings in a row while you are away (each keeps the cache warm for one more TTL).
